intro: Virginia Beach's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $113/month, down 1.7% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). Storage Stats puts the Virginia Beach metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $120, down 9.6% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $136. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $52 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$61.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $73 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$89. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $113, down 1.7% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). Storage Stats Virginia Beach metro non-climate asking rent $120, down 9.6% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Virginia Beach alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$136.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $142 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$179.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $167 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$210.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Lake Front Village (~$100), Bayville Park (~$109), Hutton Terrace (~$111) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. The Point (~$361) is among the highest.
Virginia Beach has about 80 facilities and 11.1 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
About 258,906 sq ft of new storage is projected for 2026, a increase of 43.8% from the year before (StorageCafe). Ask what month five costs before taking a move-in discount.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
